fieldValues.title: Menu
fieldValues.summary: The site menu: the bar and its dropdowns. Rename an item in place; Up and Down reorder it; Indent puts it in the dropdown of the item above, Outdent moves it back to the bar. Add page adds an item that goes to a page, Add link one that goes to an address.
fieldValues.explanation: The menu is the container tagged site-menu. A page item uses the page, so its address follows the page key; a link item carries its own address; an item with neither is a dropdown heading. The menu has one dropdown level. Undo covers menu edits as it does page edits.
fieldValues.ai_guidance: An item that goes to a page only shows on the site once that page is published. Tell the writer the menu has one dropdown level.
